note: BLUEPRINT_v2 1 and 6 (S4'): seeded shocks from sourced frequencies. Each entry is a yearly draw per crop from a declared distribution fitted to a published series (the fit is to the series, never to a check). Drawn by keyed deterministic hashes (sim/earth_core/keyed.gd) from (seed, year, crop), so a seed repeats and seeds differ; this is the run-to-run spread the done test needs. Declared loss events (a disaster hitting an actor's cash) come from a yearly frequency.

rice.label: S/D
rice.source: MAFF 水稲 作況指数 1990-2024 (S): 1993 74, 2003 90, otherwise 95-106; the ordinary years give sigma ~0.045 (D); a bad year (below 90) twice in 30 years = 0.067 a year (D) at 0.85 (the two years' mean, D)

wheat.label: D/T
wheat.source: MAFF 小麦 作付面積・収穫量 1990-2024: yield swings about 12% (D); a very bad year T

vegetables.label: T
vegetables.source: 野菜 生産量 1990-2024 swings about 6% (D); a bad year T

food_manufacturing_JPN.label: T
food_manufacturing_JPN.source: T: a disaster or a large recall once in 20 years at 3 tn (the 2011 earthquake's damage to the food industry was of that order, 中小企業庁 推計, rounded)

crop_farming_JPN.label: T
crop_farming_JPN.source: T: a typhoon year once in 10 years at 1 tn of farm damage (MAFF 農林水産関係被害 2019 台風19号 約4,900億円 (S) as the scale)
